topic: Audience coverage calculation for Excel report
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered multiple technical issues, including database errors (Code: 215) encountered when running queries on the sandbox environment. A separate issue regarding a glitchy traffic dashboard loading experience was noted and subsequently optimized by someone, reducing load time to a few seconds.

Regarding the audience coverage calculation for an Excel report, it was decided that instead of implementing complex logic using hierarchy traversal, the process would be simplified. The plan is to use `populationNumber` from the `target/audience` endpoint and pass either a list of frames or facilities as usual.
decisions: The audience coverage calculation for the Excel report will simplify the logic by explicitly writing the required `area_id` instead of using complex hierarchy traversal.
Use `populationNumber` from the `target/audience` endpoint and pass a list of frames or facilities.
action_items: Someone will implement the simplified audience coverage calculation logic today or on Monday.
